title: input_request.answered
description: A human answered. Parity with flowpilot's EventKind.INPUT_ANSWERED + AnswerSource.USER; here the source of the answer is the type of the event itself, not a column.

answer.description: The answer, as the human gave it.

answered_by.description: Who answered. Redundant with actor.ref by design: the audit of "what was asked, answered, when and by whom" has to survive a reading of the payload alone.
